order_note: No predecessor and no ordering constraint. SQL 120 needs SQL 98's aws_check_billing_default_price_cents() and aws_check_billing_charges_when_per_check_off() and SQL 96's tenant next_day_rate_cents / same_day_rate_cents columns (spec prerequisites; both applied in production). The month-end billing engine change (tenant-billing-engine.mjs: bill only the send-time events, skip voided ones, send legs only) is a separate, later Lambda step whose plan row names SQL 120 as sql_before; until it is deployed the engine reuses the event SQL 120 writes for a leg, so no fee is billed twice.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 120: sql120-usage-events-at-approval-and-send-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql120-usage-events-at-approval-and-send); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql120. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the five functions (bodies and attributes from the file, EXECUTE for the owner only), the two triggers and the covering unique index on check_billing_events (payment_transfer_id, event_type). The backfill writes rows only and is not part of the fingerprint. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.

intended_post_state.note: Five functions owned by checksops_admin, EXECUTE for the owner only: aws_check_processing_price_cents(uuid), aws_record_checkalt_billing_event(), aws_send_speed_fee_type(text), aws_send_speed_fee_cents(uuid, text), aws_record_send_speed_fee(). Triggers aws_checkalt_deposit_billing_event (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON checkalt_deposits) and aws_payment_transfer_send_speed_fee (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON payment_transfers). A unique index covering check_billing_events (payment_transfer_id, event_type) (check_billing_events_transfer_event_uidx unless one exists). No policy, grant, table or column change; SQL 98's record_check_billing_event and its trigger unchanged. Rows: the backfill adds check_processing events for October 2026 Check Alt approvals and next-day / same-day fees for October 2026 sends that have none.
